links.comparator_used: Expert-authored responses without an LLM draft (human experts answering the neuro-ophthalmology questions on their own)
links.outcome: Mean expert-rated quality and empathy of responses (1-5 scale)
links.effect: Quality: Expert + AI 4.16 ± 0.81 vs Expert 3.56 ± 1.01 (P < 0.0001). Empathy: Expert + AI 3.63 ± 0.87 vs Expert 3.26 ± 1.08 (P = 0.002).
links.tradeoff: No time cost reported: time taken for expert-created and expert-edited LLM responses was similar (P = 0.75).
links.quote: For quality ( P < 0.0001) and empathy ( P = 0.002), Expert + AI performed better than Expert.

design_hint: expert clinician editing of LLM outputs
